messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder"
set: ["tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat depression", "tell your doctor if you also use", "tell your doctor if you also use a narcotic (opioid) medication", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting", "tell your doctor if you have a thyroid disorder", "be sure your doctor knows if you also use", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "tell your doctor about all medicines you use", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell your doctor if side effects bother you a lot", "tell your doctor if you have a muscle weakness condition", "tell your doctor right away if you have a fever", "tell doctor if also use insulin or other oral diabetes medications", "tell your doctor if you have a history of seizures before starting this medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
